system_description.narrative_title: Global bond-market repricing and cross-asset contagion
system_description.narrative_summary: A worldwide repricing of interest-rate expectations—sparked by strong US jobs data and hawkish central-bank signals—is driving a broad bond-market selloff that is propagating through currencies, safe-haven assets and credit markets. Abstract system processes (rising real yields, tightening liquidity, widening credit spreads, shifting inflation and rate expectations) are interacting with concrete actors and assets (Fed, BOJ, sovereign yields, yen, gold, central-bank reserves), producing feedbacks such as FX intervention, reserve drawdowns and portfolio reallocation. Policymakers and investors are reacting in real time, linking monetary policy, fiscal strains and market liquidity into an open, dynamic system.
system_description.scope: Global fixed-income market and interest-rate expectations and their immediate cross-asset impacts: sovereign and corporate bond markets, FX (notably JPY and USD), gold and safe-haven flows, central-bank reserve actions/interventions, and short-term liquidity/credit conditions.
system_description.super_system: The global macro-financial system (world economy, international capital flows and geopolitical-financial stability).
adjacent_subsystems: Central-bank policy framework and communications (Fed, BOJ, ECB)
Sovereign fiscal policy and government debt markets
FX markets and official reserve management / FX intervention
Commodity and safe-haven markets (gold, bitcoin, oil)

variables.name: Long-term bond yield
variables.description: Level of market yields on long-dated government-grade bonds reflecting term premium and long-horizon rate expectations.

variables.name: Short-term interest rate
variables.description: Market and policy-related yields at the short end of the curve that set near-term funding costs.

variables.name: Real yield level
variables.description: Inflation-adjusted yield demanded by investors, representing expected real returns across fixed-income instruments.

variables.name: Yield curve slope
variables.description: Difference between long-term and short-term yields indicating the steepness or inversion of the term structure.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: Market and survey-implied expected inflation over relevant horizons that influence nominal rates and real returns.

variables.name: Interest-rate expectations
variables.description: Market consensus about the future path and timing of policy rate changes and central-bank tightening/loosening.

variables.name: Credit spread level
variables.description: Average premium over risk-free yields demanded by non-sovereign and lower-rated sovereign borrowers reflecting credit risk pricing.

variables.name: Market liquidity condition
variables.description: Ease of transacting in fixed-income, FX and related markets as indicated by depth, bid-ask spreads and execution capacity.

variables.name: Short-term funding stress
variables.description: Pressure and constraints in short-term wholesale funding and secured funding markets that affect liquidity availability.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flow (net)
variables.description: Net international portfolio and capital movements into or out of jurisdictions that shift asset supply and demand balances.

variables.name: Currency strength differential
variables.description: Relative valuation shifts between major currencies reflecting appreciation or depreciation pressure against peers.

variables.name: Currency intervention pressure
variables.description: Degree of political and market tension that raises the likelihood or intensity of official foreign-exchange intervention and reserve use.

variables.name: Safe-haven demand
variables.description: Investor appetite for low-risk stores of value, including high-grade debt and alternative safe assets, during risk-off episodes.

variables.name: Precious metal price level
variables.description: Market price level of key precious metals used as store-of-value instruments, indicating alternative-asset demand dynamics.

variables.name: Portfolio reallocation rate
variables.description: Speed and magnitude of investor shifts between asset classes (bonds, equities, FX, commodities) in response to market signals.

variables.name: Fiscal financing pressure
variables.description: Government borrowing needs and perceived fiscal sustainability pressures that influence sovereign supply, yield risk and investor confidence.

catalysts.title: US CPI inflation release (this week)
catalysts.description: Market-moving US inflation prints due this week that will reprice nominal yields, inflation expectations and Fed path pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'This week’s inflation data in focus'; 'Gold falls...as strong payrolls revive Fed hike bets' — CPI will rewire rate and asset pricing.

catalysts.title: September FOMC (mid-September)
catalysts.description: Mid-September Fed meeting and statement likely to confirm or delay further rate hikes, shifting short-end pricing and curve shape.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Strong jobs report sends yields higher'; 'Waller Urges Patience' — FOMC will recalibrate market tightening bets.

catalysts.title: ECB policy decision (Sep 10)
catalysts.description: Scheduled ECB interest-rate decision likely to extend or halt hikes, driving euro-area short rates and regional bond yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Thursday’s ECB Decision in Focus'; 'Deutsche Bank expects ECB to extend rate hikes through December.'

catalysts.title: Bank of Japan rate-hike in September (risk)
catalysts.description: Elevated odds of a BOJ move in September as economic data and political signals shift policy stance, affecting JGBs and FX.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Takaichi's reflationist aide projects BOJ rate hike in September'; 'Japan Q2 GDP beats forecast, supporting case for BOJ rate hike.'

catalysts.title: Continued Japanese FX intervention and reserve drawdown
catalysts.description: Ongoing interventions reflected in record reserve drawdowns as authorities respond to rapid yen moves, raising intervention pressure and FX volatility.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Japan's foreign reserves drop by a record $80 billion...following yen intervention'; 'Yen surges...traders stay alert for signs of intervention.'

catalysts.title: ECB hikes expected through December (path)
catalysts.description: Market consensus that ECB will continue tightening through year-end, gradually repricing euro-area rates and cross-border flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Deutsche Bank expects ECB to extend rate hikes through December'; 'Another rate hike...five questions for the ECB.'

catalysts.title: Amazon sterling bond issuance (near-term)
catalysts.description: Amazon's planned first-ever sterling bond sale will add supply to sterling credit markets and attract cross-border demand.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Amazon hires banks for first ever sterling bond sale' — corporate issuance to influence sterling credit markets.

catalysts.title: Continued US Treasury sell-off and 4.8% yield test
catalysts.description: Ongoing Treasury repricing that could push long yields toward the cited 4.8% test, widening spreads and stressing funding conditions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Treasury yields face 4.8% test'; 'Bond Yields Rocket to 2-Decade High' — ongoing sell-off risks wider spillovers.
